title: Skill-evaluation rubric (G37 D4)
description: The six rubric dimensions with, per dimension, the grader that answers it and the mode it gates in. Machine-readable because graders and the publication gate both need the gating mode; the plan's D4 table stays the narrative owner and this file never restates its reasoning.

repetitions.description: `k`. Deliberately not a cost knob: dropping it to 1 converts every pass^k safety gate into a single-sample check, which is the one variance a stochastic agent has and a scenario list does not.

grader.description: A judged dimension needs a model, so it cannot gate a merge under D2 (no model runs in CI) and is replayed from the bundle's judgments.json instead.

gating.description: zero_tolerance is pass^k — every repetition must pass, and it may never be baselined from a first run, since a first run containing a false green would enshrine it as the floor. baseline gates merge evidence against a per-(skill, agent, model) floor. publication_baseline gates only at publication, because --no-judge is the everyday posture.

uncertainty_rules.description: Dimension 2 only: one rule per uncertainty kind. Collapsing them into a single 'never state a verdict' rule fails an agent for being right about two of the four.
